interpretation.name: ProvideSharedNutrunnerToLine4
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 to line 4's station and tighten, evaluate and record the fasteners of line 4's variant.
constraints: Line 4 is not in the runtime plant state (only lines 1, 2 and 3 exist), so its station and variant cannot be resolved.
No Recipe is proposed until the operator confirms or corrects the line number. Station and variant must not be guessed.
The tool must be reserved before transport and released after use (E1, E6).
transport-tool must be delegated to agvexecutor (E2).
The tool must be at the station before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners (E3).
The tightening program must come only from get-program, with no literal torque or tolerance values (E4).
Every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded (E5).
interpretation.horizon: current request; pending clarification of the target line
